description: This file contains unit tests for SwiftUI view hierarchies in the OpenClaw project, utilizing the XCTest framework. It defines a test suite 'SwiftUIRenderSmokeTests' with multiple test cases that build various views, encapsulate them in UIWindow, and verify their rendering by building the view hierarchy.

classes.name: SwiftUIRenderSmokeTests
classes.description: A test suite struct that contains multiple view hierarchy tests for the OpenClaw iOS app.

methods.description: A private static method that sets up a UIWindow with a given SwiftUI view for testing.
